from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
provider = TracerProvider()
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer("existing_agent")
async def model_call(messages, client):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("chat local-demo", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "chat", "gen_ai.provider.name": "ollama", "gen_ai.request.model": "local-demo"}):
        return await client.chat(messages=messages, temperature=0.2, stream=True)
async def tool_call(arguments, handler):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("execute_tool lookup_weather", attributes={"gen_ai.operation.name": "execute_tool", "gen_ai.tool.name": "lookup_weather"}):
        return await handler(arguments)

existing_generic_otel.source_snapshot:
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter
provider = TracerProvider()
exporter = OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:55327/v1/traces", headers={"X-App-Tenant":"synthetic-tenant"})
provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(exporter))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer=trace.get_tracer("existing-http")
async def turn(messages, client):
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("HTTP POST /chat"):
        return await client.chat(messages=messages)
existing_generic_otel.source_context: Generic HTTP spans are active instrumentation; no GenAI spans exist yet. Preserve provider, existing HTTP node, custom OTLP path and harmless header while adding only actual turn and model operations through supported OTel/current-stack hooks.

existing_metrics_only.source_snapshot:
from opentelemetry import metrics
from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics import MeterProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.metrics.export import PeriodicExportingMetricReader, ConsoleMetricExporter
reader=PeriodicExportingMetricReader(ConsoleMetricExporter())
provider=MeterProvider(metric_readers=[reader])
metrics.set_meter_provider(provider)
calls=metrics.get_meter("agent").create_counter("agent.turns")
async def turn(messages, client):
    calls.add(1)
    return await client.chat(messages=messages)
existing_metrics_only.source_context: A real metric SDK/provider/exporter and counter are active; not a fresh AO default. Keep metric ownership intact and add missing trace operations with a supported OTel path, without an AO span-creation dependency.

existing_logs_only.source_snapshot:
import logging
from opentelemetry.sdk._logs import LoggerProvider, LoggingHandler
from opentelemetry.sdk._logs.export import BatchLogRecordProcessor, ConsoleLogExporter
provider=LoggerProvider()
provider.add_log_record_processor(BatchLogRecordProcessor(ConsoleLogExporter()))
logger=logging.getLogger("agent")
logger.addHandler(logging.StreamHandler())
logger.addHandler(LoggingHandler(logger_provider=provider))
async def turn(messages, client):
    logger.warning("agent turn started")
    return await client.chat(messages=messages)
existing_logs_only.source_context: A real OTel log SDK/bridge/provider/exporter is active independently of stdout. Preserve it and its original sink; no fresh AO default or forced producer migration.
